crossRefs.note: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
“ ‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do…
Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the…
but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself, and for…
nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not…
But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.
For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: This is to be a permanent statute for you, to make atonement once a year for the Israelites because of all their sins.” And all this was done as the LORD had commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make atonement for the children of Israel because of all their sins once in the year. And he did as Jehovah commanded Moses.
